summary: Verified per-timeframe (intraday/swing) structural-regime release feature end-to-end: 76 targeted backend unit tests pass, GET /api/regime-lab/releases returns 200 with correct shape and (after seeding two shadow docs 15m/4h) yields two rows each carrying band='intraday' and band='swing'. Notification config GET /api/telegram/notify-config exposes new toggle 'regime_release_ready' (default true). SettingsPanel label 'Regime bereit für „Wirksam“' is present in source. AI Trading Panel Setup section renders StructuralStagePanel with data-testid ai-structural-stage-panel, note text (ai-structural-timeframe-note) mentions both Intraday (Analyse ≤ 1h) and Swing (≥ 2h), and after seeding both crypto badges (ai-structural-stage-crypto-intraday 'Krypto Intraday: SHADOW (15m)' and ai-structural-stage-crypto-swing 'Krypto Swing: SHADOW (4h)') are rendered. Regime-Lab modal (tools-menu-regime-lab) opens with no page/runtime errors (regime-lab-modal + workflow testids present). Seed docs cleaned up afterwards (releases returned to empty list).

minor.issue: list_releases uses r['id'] without .get() at routers/regime_lab.py:452 – any regime_analyses doc missing top-level 'id' key produces a 500. Not user-reachable in normal flow (all_releases populates id), but brittle; consider r.get('id') and skip if missing.

action_items: Optional: harden routers/regime_lab.py list_releases against docs missing top-level 'id' (use r.get('id')).

notifications.DEFAULT_CONFIG['regime_release_ready']=True correctly wired; GET/PUT round-trip via /api/telegram/notify-config confirmed.
